content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Mumbai Port Authority Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.mumbaiport.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 21-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Mumbai Port Authority for hiring Professional Interns in various fields.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies have been announced for Professional Intern positions across multiple specializations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of filled-in offline application forms is 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly through offline mode by sending the physical form to the designated address.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary provided for these posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs 50,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must be less than 35 years of age as on 01.10.2026 to be eligible for these positions.

faq.question: Q7. Where should I send the completed application form?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the Deputy Conservator's Office, Mumbai Port Authority, Port Bhavan, 1st Floor, S.V. Marg, Ballard Estate, Mumbai 400 001.

faq.question: Q8. What educational qualifications are required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a degree in relevant fields such as Marine, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical Engineering, Nautical Science, Data Science, or Commerce with IT.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment process.

faq.question: Q10. How can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the notification and application form directly from the official Mumbai Port Authority website at www.mumbaiport.gov.in.
